title: Give — Baker Road Baptist Church
metaDescription: Three ways to give to Baker Road Baptist Church in Baytown: online, in person on Sunday morning, or by mail.
headline: Three ways, all of them simple.
intro: If you are visiting, please skip this page. Giving is for people who call Baker Road home.

sections.heading: Generosity answers generosity
sections.body:
God gave first, and gave everything. What we do with what we have been given says a great deal about the condition of our hearts. So giving here is not the price of admission and it is not the church's fundraising. It is a response.

What it pays for is not abstract. Everything below is funded by people who call Baker Road home, giving on ordinary Sundays.
sections.note: “For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.” — Matthew 6:21

items.title: The work here
items.body: The teaching, the children's ministry, the care of members in hard seasons, and the building on Baker Road that this congregation has paid for since 1978.

items.title: Baytown, outside our doors
items.body: The Pumpkin Patch every October, rides to church for anyone without a way to get here, meals and hospital visits through the Care Ministry, and direct help for neighbors who are up against it — whether or not they attend here.

items.title: Around the world
items.body: Missionaries in the field, supported through the cooperative work of Southern Baptist churches, as this church has done since the beginning.

items.title: On Sunday morning
items.body: Envelopes are available for cash or checks.

items.title: Send a check
items.body: Make it payable to Baker Road Baptist Church. 900 W. Baker Road, Baytown, Texas 77521.
